coordinate-plane.first-quadrant.note: 'Plot and read' is two inverse procedures with different test problems. Edges that need the structure of the plane rather than either procedure should point at coordinate-plane.ordered-pair.meaning or coordinate-plane.axes-origin. Both new nodes are whole-number coordinates only; fraction or decimal coordinates (used by some ratio and proportional-relationship graphs) need a later node.

data.graphs.read.note: Broader than one node: reading a one-mark-per-point chart or picture graph needs only counting, while reading a bar graph needs a scale. Reading scaled picture and bar graphs (3.MD.B.3), line plots, and tables belong to later strands; a re-pointing pass should send each of the 3 old edges to the specific read node its source node needs, which may be a later-phase node.

measurement.unit-conversion.note: Conversion splits by direction (multiply to a smaller unit, divide to a larger one) and by the number kind of the measure or result (whole, two-unit, decimal, fraction), because each needs a different computation as prerequisite (whole-number product, quotient with remainder, multiplying or dividing by a power of ten, fraction times whole number or a divided by b = a/b). Re-point an old edge to to-smaller.whole when the referring node only needs whole-number conversion to a smaller unit (the 4.MD.A.1 meaning); to the relevant directional node otherwise.
